name: Chain Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You can cast spells that affect whole swathes of enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Any metamagic feat.

Benefit(s): Any spell you cast which affects a single target and has a range greater than touch can be chained to affect a number of secondary targets equal to your caster level. You choose a primary target as normal and then choose any number of secondary targets up to your caster level within 30 feet of the original target.

Secondary targets make any associated saving throws with a +2 bonus, in addition if the effect deals damage secondary targets take only half the normal damage before any reduction for saving throws or other effects.

A chained spell uses a spell slot three levels higher than the original spell.
